description: Compare two crawls of the same site and report which issues are new in the later crawl, which were fixed, and how many persist. Use it to answer "did my changes help?" or "what regressed since the last deploy?", and to gate a release: only the new_issues list represents a regression, so a pre-existing backlog never counts against a change. Get both session ids from list_crawls; base_session is the earlier crawl.

base_session.description: Session id of the earlier ("before") crawl.

compare_session.description: Session id of the later ("after") crawl.

name: compare_crawls
